com.even.derivation.method: Zero-chroma OKLCH endpoints; solve encoded-sRGB source-over for alpha, rounded to 6 decimals.
com.even.derivation.usage: Shadows or overlays where the background should show through. Dark white-alpha overlays lighten; cast shadows and modal dimming require black.
